BiblicalUsage: Dodai the Ahohite was the captain of the second month's course, commanding twenty-four thousand men in David's army. His name stands in the list of the monthly captains.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the captains are listed because God's people were organized for service, and every month had its man ready.
